summary.name: ThreeDee Nova AI 3D Generator
summary.one_liner: A web-based AI tool that generates 3D models from a text prompt or a single image, with downloadable mesh files.
use_cases: Converting a single image into a 3D model
summary.what_it_does: The page describes ThreeDee Nova, an AI tool that creates 3D models from a text prompt or an uploaded image by drag and drop. Each generated model is described as a clean, optimized mesh delivered as a ready-to-use 3D file for download. The page says the process is fully automated and takes minutes rather than days. A gallery of community-generated models is shown, all said to come from single text prompts. Pricing is credit-based, with one credit producing one 3D model.
notable: Accepts either a text prompt or a single image as input
Outputs a clean, optimized mesh ready for games, AR/VR or design
Credit-based plans where higher tiers lower the per-model price
Community gallery of models generated from single text prompts
caveats: Paid plans only, listed from $3 (3 credits) to $15 (20 credits); each credit equals one 3D model
Pro plan shows a struck-through $20 price and 'priority access for early customers'
Output format and file types are not specified on the page
